attention.alt: Attention of Q, K and V equals the softmax of Q times K transposed divided by the square root of d, times V

cache_size.alt: s layer equals 2 times h times d times w times T, and s cache equals L times s layer

attention2.alt: A equals the softmax of Q times K transposed divided by the square root of d, and the output equals A times V

cache_layer.alt: s layer equals 2 times h times d times w times T

cache_total.alt: s cache equals L times s layer

pk_defs.alt: S equals 8 s over C, and rho equals lambda times the expected value of S

chunk_max.alt: the chunk payload is at most B minus 64 minus the length of the key

hessian.alt: the Hessian of the log-sum-exp function equals the diagonal matrix of pi minus pi times pi transposed, which is positive semidefinite

yi.alt: y i equals 1 over the square root of d, times the sum over j of H i j times delta j times u j

wire.alt: t wire equals 8 times s cache divided by C

hol.alt: W equals 8 over C, times the sum of s i for i from 1 to k

pk.alt: the mean wait W bar equals lambda times the expected value of S squared, divided by 2 times 1 minus rho

bound.alt: X is at most N times B divided by t credit

staging.alt: t copy divided by t wire equals s over P divided by 8 s over C, which equals C divided by 8 P

softmax.alt: the probability of next state s prime, given state s and transfer x, equals the exponential of W s s prime dot phi of x, divided by the sum over the three states r of the exponential of W s r dot phi of x

objective.alt: J of W equals minus one over n times the sum over the n examples of the logarithm of the probability of the labeled next state, plus eta over 2 times the squared length of W, with eta greater than zero

queues.alt: the rate of change of q H equals lambda H minus u times C times mu H, and the rate of change of q C equals lambda C minus 1 minus u, times C times mu C

switching.alt: S equals p H times C times mu H, minus p C times C times mu C

implemented.alt: alpha times q H times mu H is greater than beta times q C times mu C, which with the default values means q H greater than one tenth of q C

consistent.alt: alpha times q H divided by mu H is greater than beta times q C divided by mu C, which with the default values means q H greater than two and a half times q C

rotation.alt: y equals 1 over the square root of d, times H times D times u

hadamard.alt: H 1 is the one by one matrix 1, and H of 2 n is the two by two block matrix with rows H n, H n and H n, minus H n

rrt.alt: R equals 1 over the square root of d, times H d times D, and R times R transposed equals the identity

variance.alt: the expected value of y i is zero and the variance of y i is 1 over d

score.alt: Score of q equals the inner product of q and x hat, plus rho times the square root of pi over 2 divided by m, times the sum over the m projections of z j times the inner product of s j and q

packed.alt: s packed equals 4 plus 4 plus the ceiling of d times b over 8, plus the ceiling of m over 8

reconstruct.alt: x hat equals l over the square root of d, times D times H times y hat

batching.alt: X of n equals n times s block, divided by t fix plus n times t block, which tends to s block divided by t block as n grows

penalty.alt: penalty equals the 99th percentile of the hot latency with the cold stream on, divided by the 99th percentile with the cold stream off

ttft.alt: time to first token equals t prefill plus t transfer plus t first decode

oneway.alt: one-way latency equals round-trip time divided by two

proof54a.alt: K minus N, times t credit, is at most N times t observed, so K is at most N plus N times t observed divided by t credit

proof54b.alt: X is at most B times K divided by t observed, which is at most N times B divided by t observed, plus N times B divided by t credit

delta.alt: Delta of x equals minus gamma P times t p minus tau P times p, minus gamma D times t e minus tau D times e

hht.alt: H d times H d transposed equals d times the identity

sketch_est.alt: the inner product of q and r is estimated by the length of r times the square root of pi over 2 divided by m, times the sum of z j times the inner product of s j and q, where z j is the sign of the inner product of s j and r

sketch_est2.alt: the inner product of q and r is estimated by the length of r times the square root of pi over 2 divided by m, times the sum of z j times the inner product of s j and q

sketch_sd.alt: the standard deviation is at most the square root of pi over 2 m, times the length of r times the length of q

lemma610.alt: the expected value of the sign of X times Y equals the square root of 2 over pi, times kappa divided by sigma

window.alt: N times B equals 8 times 4 mebibytes, which is 32 mebibytes

softmax_def.alt: the softmax of z at entry i equals e to the z i, divided by the sum over j of e to the z j

wire_num.alt: t wire equals 8 times s cache divided by C, which is 8 times 160 times 2 to the 20, divided by 10 to the 10, seconds, which is 134.2 milliseconds

hol_num.alt: W equals 8 over C times the sum of s i for i from 1 to k, which is 8 times 4 times 2 to the 20, divided by 10 to the 10, seconds, which is 3.36 milliseconds

cache_num.alt: s layer equals 2 times 8 times 64 times 2 times T, which is 2,048 times T bytes

batch_time.alt: the time of a batch of n blocks equals t fix plus n times t block

amdahl.alt: S of N equals 1 divided by the sum of 1 minus P and P over N
